name: Chili Con Queso (Nacho Cheese Dip)
description: A warm, cheesy dip made with cream cheese, cheddar cheese soup, and processed cheese, perfect for tortilla chips.
recipeIngredient: 10 oz can (284 mL) cheddar cheese soup

recipeInstructions.text: Let the cream cheese stand at room temperature to warm up.
In a saucepan, melt the cream cheese over heat.
Add the cheddar cheese soup, stirring constantly until well combined.
Crumble the processed cheese into smaller pieces and melt it into the cheese mixture.
Add salsa to taste, adjusting the amount based on the type of salsa used.
Serve the Chili Con Queso hot with tortilla chips as a dip, or cold with tacos or chili.

keywords: nacho cheese dip, chili con queso, cheesy dip, tortilla chip dip
